# SNOVA

This directory contains the tools for generating the recommended SNOVA Round 3 parameter instances.

Run `make` to build the available implementations in the `ref`, `opt`, `avx2`, `mem`, and `tiny` directories.

In each of these directories, the following commands are available:

```bash
make clean kat speed
make speed
make digest
```

The `make clean kat speed` command removes previous build artifacts, generates the Known Answer Tests (KATs), and compiles and runs the performance benchmarks. The second `make speed` command runs the performance benchmarks without displaying the build output. The `make digest` command generates the KAT digests.

Building SNOVA requires a C compiler and `make`; no additional dependencies are required.

## KAT Digests

The `KATs` file contains the 24-byte SHAKE256 digests of the SNOVA KAT files. It is generated by running `make digest` after building the corresponding implementation.

The official SNOVA Round 3 KAT files are available in the [SNOVA_KAT repository](https://github.com/PQCLAB-SNOVA/SNOVA_KAT).
